Hello everyone,

I am submitting a small pull request to add two Frobenius and rank-one trace formulas in Matrix:
1. Matrix.trace_vecMulVec_eq_dotProduct
2. Matrix.trace_transpose_mul_self_eq_sum_sq

Why this is useful:
Relating the trace of an outer product vecMulVec u v to u ⬝ᵥ v, and the trace of the Gram matrix Aᵀ * A to the double sum of squared entries, bridges matrix trace calculations with explicit entrywise sums over finite index types.

Brief school-style derivation:
Step 1: Expand Matrix.trace (Matrix.vecMulVec u v) on diagonal entries i = j, which gives ∑ i, u i * v i, matching the definition of u ⬝ᵥ v.
Step 2: For Matrix.trace (Aᵀ * A), expand the trace of the product as ∑ j, ∑ i, (Aᵀ) j i * A i j = ∑ j, ∑ i, A i j * A i j.
Step 3: Swap the outer sum over j and the inner sum over i via Finset.sum_comm to get ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * A i j.

Kindly review this small addition when convenient.

ai is being used as a tool
